_comment: Project-level pi-lens config. Global-only settings (e.g. opengrep.enabled) must be set in ~/.pi-lens/config.json, NOT here. The 'gitleaks' key was previously here but is NOT a valid pi-lens setting — gitleaks is controlled via its own .gitleaksignore / .gitleaks.toml files in the project root, or via the gitleaks binary directly.

rules.comment: Pi-lens project rules. These are project-scoped settings that supplement (not replace) the global config.
